t: Exceptional Engineering S1 - "Hightech in the Air"
d: The Airbus A350 proves its high-tech capabilities during a demanding 12-hour maiden long-haul flight from Munich to Hong Kong.

t: Bridging the Expanse S1 - "Baring All in Steel"
d: Engineers during the Great Depression design intricate skeletal steel structures, optimizing material efficiency to boost global economies.

t: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Bridges: City Icons"
d: Here are ten of the world greatest modern bridges - engineering marvels and architectural masterpieces from around the world.

t: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Transport Megastructures-Engineering Wonders"
d: The Trans-Siberian Railway, New York City Subway, Channel Tunnel and Suez Canal are only some of the breathtaking megastructures devised by humanity.

t: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Museums and Galleries: Architectural Treasures"
d: Bilbao, Amsterdam, Antwerp and Florence belong to a dynamic group of cities that preserve the heritage of humanity through museums.

t: Bright Now S1 - "The Science of Cute"
d: Domestication shaped wolves into dogs and transformed both their behavior and their anatomy. New discoveries show how dogs produce a very specific eyebrow movement more often than wolves do.

t: Megastructures: Gardens By The Bay
d: Discover the making of Singapore’s Gardens by the Bay, where groundbreaking engineering created a spectacular urban oasis unlike any other.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Striker II, Navy Drones, F35B Fighter"
st: Striker II, Navy Drones, F35B Fighter
d: We have rare acces to BAE Systems. At their research centre in Kent, they're developing the futuristic Striker II helmet giving fighter pilots the edge in aerial combat.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Live Fire Exercises, Body Armor, Armored Vehicle AJAX"
st: Live Fire Exercises, Body Armor, Armored Vehicle AJAX
d: Discover the latest innovations in kit and equipment at the key military and security exhibition in the UK; Lockheed Martin's heat-seeking Indago drone; and the tech spec on the British Army's new armored vehicle, the AJAX.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Battlefield 3-D, Drone Tech, 2-man Orcasub"
d: The innovative combination of 3D video and drone technology gives infantry soldiers an accurate battlefield picture. Northrop Grumman's top European executive shares their predictions on how technology will change the way we fight.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle"
st: USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle
d: We reveal eye-witness intelligence on the USS Zumwalt, America's ultra-hi tech, four billion dollar guided missile destroyer. Learn more about the British firm who've developed Minerva, an ingenious, low-cost but realistic tank simulator.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower"
st: Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
d: The Military Tech Show captures the moment when BAE System's radical new pilot helmet, the Striker II, goes operational for the first time in a Typhoon fighter aircraft; how interactive technology is helping train military combat medics.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones"
st: Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones
d: European manufacturer MBDA give a hands-on demonstration of their state-of-the-art missile, the Spear 3. Learn how scientists are using a virtual reality headset to see the battlefield in a revealing new way.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
st: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection
d: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck"
st: RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck
d: We're at Royal Air Force station Brize Norton, Oxfordshire, where we've been given an exclusive look at the RAF's ground-breaking, multi-role refuelling and transporter aircraft, the Voyager.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Targeting & Tracking, Navigation, Seagoing Drones"
d: We reveal an experimental sensor, monitoring and targeting system developed for troops by the UK's Defence Science and Technology Laboratory and Roke Manor Research. The iXblue Marins navigation black box guides navy ships.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping"
st: NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping
d: We visit NATO's Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation in La Spezia, Italy. We learn how the world's oceans are one of the last places that military technology can be hidden from prying eyes.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics"
st: Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics
d: With an increasing terrorist threat to ports and shipping, the Swedish manufacturer SAAB has developed the Sea Wasp, an under-water robot for detecting explosive devices.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Warrior Vehicles, British Special Forces"
d: We're in Scotland for Unmanned Warrior, the key international military exercise using unmanned underwater, surface and airborne vehicles. We visit the Italian textile manufacturer who's kitting from a revolutionary new form of wool.

t: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Fuel for Destruction"
d: The atomic age introduces powerful rockets and nuclear energy, balancing technological advancement with threats like the Chernobyl disaster.

t: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Golden Age of Science"
d: Military funding drives a boom in earth sciences and biological research, creating advanced weapons alongside deeper insights into our world.

t: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Information Is Power"
d: Cold War secrecy accelerates spy tech, satellite surveillance, and early computer networks, laying the foundation for modern global communications.

t: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Race to Space"
d: Superpower rivalries turn missile tech toward orbital supremacy, driving historic milestones from early satellite launches to landing on the moon.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Artillery"
d: Artillery, the King of Battle, is explored as gunners train with powerful weapons and prepare for modern combat deployment.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "First Ten Combat Missions"
d: During the Vietnam War, the USAF learned most pilot losses happened in their first 10 missions, leading to intense training that saves lives.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Army Combatives"
d: At Fort Benning’s Army Combatives School, soldiers train in brutal hand-to-hand combat, learning real-world skills to fight and survive.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Stealth Submarines"
d: Stealthy diesel submarines challenge nuclear subs. Inside a NATO exercise, we explore why they’re so deadly in the Norwegian fjords.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Heavy Armor"
d: Tank crews train for deployment, mastering modern armored warfare where heavy tanks protect soldiers and dominate the battlefield.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Snipers"
d: Silent and deadly, snipers train in elite schools, mastering long‑range weapons, stealth, and fieldcraft to become the battlefield’s ultimate asset.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Urban Warfare"
d: Urban combat is brutal and unforgiving. At training sites worldwide, soldiers learn the tactics and teamwork needed to survive deadly city battles.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Fighter Pilots"
d: New pilots train in air‑to‑air combat at an international exercise, mastering dogfighting and modern fighter jet technology.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Paratroopers"
d: Airborne troops train as force multipliers, learning how paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to seize targets and launch ambushes.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Combat Medics"
d: Combat medics risk it all to save soldiers under fire. We join their training to see what it takes to save lives in the field.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Basic Training"
d: Basic training transforms civilians into soldiers, sailors, and airmen through intense physical and psychological tests.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Combat Fitness"
d: Combat fitness builds soldiers’ strength, endurance, and resilience, teaching skills crucial for survival, sometimes adapted for civilians.

t: War Factories S1 - "German Aviation"
d: The untold secret story of war production that shaped the WWII, beginning with how the German aviation industry came to dominate the skies of Europe.

t: War Factories S1 - "Krupp"
d: The story behind the Krupp company, who were responsible for the manufacture of two of Germany's most feared war products - the Panzer Tank and the U-boat.

t: War Factories S1 - "Vickers"
d: The role played by engineering giant Vickers during the WWII, including the development of the Spitfire.

t: War Factories S1 - "General Motors"
d: How the Americans out-produced the rest of the world so quickly and by such a huge margin, including the likes of General Motors.

t: War Factories S1 - "US Aviation"
d: Henry Ford's plan to build a giant factory in Michigan, covering 3.5million sq ft and including an aircraft production line half a mile in length.

t: War Factories S1 - "Occupied Territories"
d: The sabotaging efforts of Peugeot in Nazi-occupied France, where the bosses and workers cooperated with the Resistance to hinder the Nazis' use of military vehicles.

t: War Factories S1 - "US Ships"
d: The story of America's `Liberty Ships', which were produced in incredible numbers and became known as the Model T Fords of the ocean.

t: War Factories S1 - "Episode 08"
d: The remarkable story of how Stalin's massive war factories were dismantled and moved east on one and half million railway trucks, to avoid being lost to the Nazis.

t: More Curious? S1 - "History of the Roller Skate"
d: Take a ride through the history of the roller skate, explore the ancient art of baking, and find out more about the versatile Bamboo plant and it’s many uses’ from medicine to musical instruments.

t: More Curious? S1 - "Chopsticks, Coffee and Coins"
d: Find our about chopsticks, coffee, coins, cooking and cotton, in this exciting episode that also explores the various Dinosaurs and what it’s like to feel and prepare for an Earthquake.

t: More Curious? S1 - "What do Karate, and Kick Boxing have in common?"
st: What do Karate, and Kick Boxing have in common?
d: Be more curious about the science of fossils and explore what’s on offer at the modern and popular gyms. What exactly is Induction Cooking and what do Karate, and Kick Boxing have in common?

t: More Curious? S1 - "What is the Moon made of?"
st: What is the Moon made of?
d: What is milk? What is the Moon made of? How are Pencil’s made? Plus Roller Coasters, Rulers, Sail Boats, Snakes and more in this episode of More Curious.

t: More Curious? S1 - "Eerie sounds of a Violin"
d: Find out more about yacht’s, the seasons and sushi, plus explore the martial art of Taekwondo. Take a look at the devastation left in the wake of a Tsunami, and the playful and eerie sounds of a Violin.

t: More Curious? S1 - "World’s Most Used Medications"
d: Ultimate is a game more commonly known as Frisbee, we’ll take a look at one of the world’s most used medications, Asprin as well as the Cello, Tattoo’s, Tea, Thanksgiving and Recycling.

t: More Curious? S1 - "3D Printing Technology and Cloud Storage"
d: Take a deep dive into 3D Printing technology and Cloud Storage. Discover all there is to know about Trains, Mammals, what is an aerosol spray plus signs ad treatments of the Common Cold.

t: More Curious? S1 - "What Makes a Storm?"
d: Take a look at the many woodwind instruments, explore the benefits of tablet computers, plus find out what makes a storm! We cover the history of speakers, rubbing alcohol and find out about the planets.

t: More Curious? S1 - "What are the many functions of our Nose?"
st: What are the many functions of our Nose?
d: Bass describes musical instruments with a low or deep frequency, passports are essential for global travel and what are the many functions of our Nose? Other topics covered include Blood pressure, Cinema, Pop and Comics.

t: More Curious? S1 - "What are blades?"
d: What is asphalt and how is it used? What are blades? Discover dishwashers and Irons and explore Greek mythology. Plus many more questions answered in this episode of More Curious.

t: More Curious? S1 - "From Blenders to Boomerangs"
d: From blenders to boomerangs, air fryers to mummies, learn about the in’s and out’s of these items and topics plus an in depth look at e - sports covered in this episode.

t: More Curious? S1 - "What are acoustics?"
d: This episode answers the big questions. What are acoustics? How can you learn to code? What are fiber optics, and how effective are herbal medicines? Plus much more!

t: More Curious? S1 - "Memory, Mining and Soil"
d: Explore the many knots and when to use them. Take a look at mixed martial arts, find out what a satellite is, and discover more about your memory, mining and soil.

t: Race of Life S1 - "Survival of the Fittest"
d: Animals adapt for survival. Crocodiles, ancient and resilient, boast slow metabolism and efficient physiology. Sharks retain successful traits over time. Whales, from land to sea, evolve with echolocation and robust anatomy, ensuring survival.

t: Race of Life S1 - "The Big Cats"
d: Cheetahs race towards endangerment.Leopards thrive as opportunistic hunters.Lions reign atop the food chain. Snow leopards navigate treacherous terrain.Tigers persevere. Each big cat surviving maturity claims victory in life's relentless race.

t: Race of Life S1 - "The Great Desert Race"
d: Deserts, harsh and arid, challenge life with scant rainfall. Desert animals adapt to conserve water, relying on food for hydration. They seek shade, burrow, or became nocturnal to survive extreme temperatures.

t: Race of Life S1 - "Herbivores"
d: Elephants, thrive on vegetation, though they're not averse to confrontation. Rhinos, resilient yet endangered, face threats from predators and humanity. Hippos, formidable and protective, safeguard their young from crocodiles and other predators.

t: Race of Life S1 - "Natural Warriors"
d: Males and females of most species will fight viciously in self-defense.Females, can be even more aggressive than males when defending their young. We'll expore the Race of Life from the point of view of food,territory,social status and mates.

t: Race of Life S1 - "Run Like the Wind"
d: Speed is primary defense mechanism, evident in antelopes evading cheetahs. Over millennia, this evolutinary arms race has honer both predator and prey skills.

t: Race of Life S1 - "The Early Bird (Catches the Worm)"
d: Analyzing bird predator-prey dynamics reveals three common scenarios: clibing flight, horizontal speeding, and evasive diving.

t: Race of Life S1 - "Reptiles"
d: Turtles,with their protective shells,persist as ancient survivors in diverse habitats.Snakes,from venomous cobras to harmless species, share common traits and sun-dependent lifestyles.Lizards' adaptive skills include tail loss as a defense mechanism.

t: Race of Life S1 - "Defenses"
d: Defense mechanisms vary widely, from hyena jaws to frog speed and spider silk. Winning life's race requires a strong defense against predators' advances.

t: Race of Life S1 - "Underwater Predators"
d: In the depths of the ocean, predators reign supreme, from sharks to moray eels.

t: Race of Life S1 - "Underwater Prey's Defenses"
d: Life in the ocean demands constant adaptation for survival. From camouflage to group safety, animals employ various strategies to evade predators and secure food.

t: Race of Life S1 - "The Race Underfoot"
d: Insects thrive in the relentless Race of Life, with diverse shapes and colors aiding their success.

t: Race of Life S1 - "The After Dark"
d: Delve into the shadows to uncover the secrets of nocturnal survival.

t: Saving the Mustang - America's Horse on the Brink
d: Saving The Mustang explores the state of wild horses today through the efforts of three individuals. All stories interweave a compelling tale of perseverance and determination.

t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Mega Towing"
d: Specialized XXL tow units execute high-risk rescue missions, retrieving heavy military vehicles and towing the world's largest aircraft.

t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Antonov An-225"
d: Equipped with six engines, the Antonov An-225 transports massive electrical transformers across the high Andes mountains.

t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Steel Giant"
d: In open-pit mines, the massive F60 overburden conveyor bridge moves up to 90,000 tons of soil per shift to extract coal.

t: Heavy Lifting S1 - "The Need for Speed"
d: Maxum Crane tackles a tight indoor lift, JP removes a 60-year-old fighter jet, and Brad and Nathan race to install farm machinery before a storm hits.

t: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Son of a Sailor"
d: Dan and Francis pull boats for winter. Maxum replaces a ferry engine. Brad and Nathan face tricky container moves. J.P. finishes by greasing the boom.

t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Crystal Glass/Flat Screen TVs/Deepest Pool/Ketchup"
d: How do they blow the world’s finest crystal wine glasses? How do they make the world’s slimmest TVs? How do they heat the world’s deepest swimming pool? How do they fill a million bottles a day of the world’s favourite ketchup?

t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Pulverizer/Bomber Jackets/Lambic Beer/"
d: How do they forge a set of jaws that can chomp through concrete and demolish tower blocks? How do they stitch the historic airman’s bomber? How do they brew the oldest beer in the Western World?

t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Sydney Opera House/Handsaws/Microphones/Icebreaker"
d: How do they cool Sydney’s famous Opera House? How do they turn Sheffield steel into a carpenter’s handsaw? How do they make a microphone that can pick up a whisper? How do they steer a safe course through a frozen river?

t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Moonshine/e-bikes/Wetsuits"
d: How do they brew moonshine in the heart of New York City? How do they make a battery powered bicycle that can do nearly 30mph? How do they grow the rubber for wetsuits in the Arizona desert?

t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Gemstones/Cowboy Boots/Road Sweepers"
d: How do they mine one of the rarest gemstones in the world? How do they craft the classic cowboy boot? How do they build a monster road sweeper that can pick up 7 tonnes of trash?

t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Duvets/Drill Pipes/Rubber Bands"
d: How do they make the world’s softest duvets? How do they drill for oil thousands of metres below ground? How do they put the stretch in the world’s stretchiest rubber bands?

t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Aircraft Engines/Fisherman’s Friend/Plastic Bank Notes/Ice Cream"
st: Aircraft Engines/Fisherman’s Friend/Plastic Bank Notes/Ice Cream
d: How do they build a diesel engine that can fly? How do they make the cough sweet that's been keeping throats clear for 150 years? How do they turn clear plastic into unforgeable bank notes? How do they do the world’s favourite ice cream flavours?

t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Armored Car/Christmas Trees/Cymbals"
d: How do they turn a family car into a fortress on wheels? How do they grow millions of perfect Christmas Trees? How do they hammer out the world’s best cymbals?

t: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Strike Planes"
d: Take a look at the history of creating stronger, faster and more powerful military aircraft.

t: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Combat Helicopters"
d: Ultimate Combat Helicopters offers a fascinating perspective on the technology used to create today’s most powerful combat helicopters.

t: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Thrill Rides"
d: Explore the ultimate adrenaline rush – the world’s fastest and scariest thrill rides.

t: Suppressed Science S1 - "The Suppressed Science Of Psychedelics"
d: Join Athena as she explores the underground world of psychedelic science, and the revolutionary impact it is poised to have on the pharmaceutical industries.

t: Suppressed Science S1 - "Race: Science, Social Construct, or Both?"
st: Race: Science, Social Construct, or Both?
d: The concept of race was invented during colonial and imperialist eras as a means to reify political power structures.

t: Suppressed Science S1 - "Weather Control: The Debate Over Geo-Engineering"
st: Weather Control: The Debate Over Geo-Engineering
d: In this episode, Athena takes on the controversial topic of Geoengineering, and meets scientists working on an ambitious plan to put a shield around the planet.

t: Suppressed Science S1 - "Human Enhancement"
d: From a cutting-edge, science-based gym & spa, to a medical clinic that offers direct ultrasound brain stimulation designed to increase mental performance.

t: Supersonic: The Great Adventure
d: The epic story of 70 years of supersonic innovation, from Chuck Yeager's breakthrough to the future of flight.

t: The Aviators S3 - "Winter Flying"
d: Anthony shows us the different methods to keep yourself and your plane warmed up in those cold winter months.

t: The Aviators S3 - "Night Time Flying"
d: Kurtis and Anthony take us night flying. Some say it's more beautiful... while others think it's more dangerous!

t: The Aviators S3 - "Guardian Angels"
d: Experiencing an aviation emergency where the calm voice on the other end of the radio helps get our pilot out of trouble.

t: The Aviators S3 - "Oxygen Lab"
d: Kurtis experiences oxygen deprivation in the High Altitude Lab at Embry Riddle University.

t: Deep Rising
d: 'Deep Rising' narrated and executive produced by Jason Momoa, takes viewers on journey from the oceans depths to the future of sustainable energy.

t: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Megafloods"
d: Witness the devastating destructive power unleashed by planet earth’s most valuable resource – water.

t: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Constructions"
d: Discover the worst bridge collapses and tunnel fires in history.

t: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Hurricanes"
d: Explore with us one of the most destructive and deadliest hurricanes in history!

t: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Earthquakes"
d: Explore with us the most destructive earthquakes in history, can we even protect ourselves from this natural disaster?

t: Rethink S1 - "Rotoscoping"
d: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we’ll discuss the animation technique of Rotoscoping, take another look at card tricks, the history of juggling and the popularity of the Smart phone.

t: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hoxha's Bunker Madness"
d: Paranoid and isolated, Albanian dictator Enver Hoxha establishes his bunkerization project, which would result in the construction of more than 170,000 bunkers.

t: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker"
d: Infamous for the bunkers constructed during World War II and throughout the Cold War, Stalin’s hideouts have maintained a shroud of secrecy for decades, and are now seen for the first time.

t: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Yanukovych's Hidden Palace"
d: Having stolen billions from the populace, Ukrainian dictator Viktor Yanukovych hides his treasure trove in a mind-bending corruption scheme that leads to Mezhyhirya, a 150-acre estate, with secret underground tunnels.

t: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Ceausescu's Delusions of Grandeur"
d: Casa Poporlui is the magnum opus of Romania’s most bloodthirsty dictator, Nicolae Ceausescu, and hides secrets of an extensive underground bunker system.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher"
st: A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher
d: A battle tank is only as effective as its gun, and for the Stryker vehicle, that’s the M68 105mm cannon. A tube of forged steel will be hammered into the one of the most powerful and famous cannons in modern warfare.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
st: A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs
d: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
st: Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch
d: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .

t: War Factories S2 - "Battle For Black Gold"
d: The story of the discovery and exploitation of the Baku Oilfields in the Russian Caucasus, which forced Stalin and Hitler to face-off in the battle of Stalingrad.

t: War Factories S2 - "Fiat And The Fascists"
d: The untold story of World War II. No matter how many soldiers or how daring the strategy, a war cannot be won if there are not enough weapons or food.

t: War Factories S2 - "The People's Car"
d: The untold story of World War II. No matter how many soldiers or how daring the strategy, a war cannot be won if there are not enough weapons or food.

t: War Factories S2 - "Apocalypse Factories"
d: The incredible story of the arms race to create America's nuclear arms factories.

t: War Factories S2 - "The Kamikaze Bullet"
d: Japan would create arguably the greatest fighter in WW2 - the Mitsubishi Zero. But their failed War Factories would ultimately reduce the Zero to a Kamikaze plane.

t: How Things Work S1 - "Refrigerators, Electric Guitars and Garden Sprinklers"
st: Refrigerators, Electric Guitars and Garden Sprinklers
d: Ticket barrier, refrigerator, electric guitar, grass trimmer, garden sprinkler and movie camera lens... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

t: How Things Work S1 - "Paintball Guns, Ice Machines and Pool Tables"
st: Paintball Guns, Ice Machines and Pool Tables
d: Paintball gun, floor scrubber, ice machine, pool table, shopping trolley, gas boiler... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

t: How Things Work S1 - "Hiking Boots, Pianos and Vending Machines"
st: Hiking Boots, Pianos and Vending Machines
d: Car winch, hiking boot, coffee machine, piano, vending machine, abseil catch... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

t: How Things Work S1 - "Skateboards, Vacuum Cleaners and ATMs"
d: Skateboard, vacuum cleaner, ATM, car jack, digital projector, and multi-tool... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

t: Bright Now S1 - "Hacking our Microbiome"
d: Every person is playing host to at least 40 trillion non-human microorganisms. Collectively, these microbes constitute what's called our microbiome.

t: Science of Thrills S1 - "Longest"
d: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell investigates four of the longest roller coasters in Europe and America.

t: Science of Thrills S1 - "Psychological"
d: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell investigates four theme park rides in Europe and America which use psychological tricks to add to the thrills.

t: Science of Thrills S1 - "Fun"
d: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell investigates four theme park rides in Europe and America which mix fun along with the the thrills.

t: Science of Thrills S1 - "Design"
d: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell finds out what it takes to design and build the next generation of rollercoasters.

t: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Sleep"
d: Jack meets two people who can’t stop falling asleep and finds out the consequences of sleep deprivation.

t: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Language"
d: Jack meets a British man who awoke from a coma speaking only fluent French.

t: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Lying"
d: Dr Jack Lewis also meets an incredible man who woke from a coma to his brain producing a string of lies, he was confabulating.

t: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Risk"
d: Dr Jack meets extreme risk taker Matthew Adams. Will tests at the University of Cambridge show that Matthew has a different brain from non-risk taking Jack?

t: Earthrise S1 - "Coping With Extremes"
d: Earthrise assesses the depth of the crisis facing the world’s grasslands today, and explores some of the solutions that are being used to preserve them.

t: Earthrise S1 - "Fighting Insectageddon"
d: Earthrise travels to New Zealand and Essex, UK to visit two projects that are working to protect the 'little guys that run the world' - insects.

t: Earthrise S1 - "Winds Of Change"
d: Earthrise travels to India and Denmark, to explore two innovative movements that are helping to drive down green-house gas emissions.

t: Earthrise S1 - "Human-Wildlife Conflict"
d: Earthrise travels to Bangladesh and Australia, to visit two projects that have found ways for humans and animals to live better together on our shared planet.

t: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Research in Remote Locations"
d: In this episode, we visit a few remote areas to see how research and restoration is conducted.

t: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Science Communicators"
d: In this episode, we’ll meet a few different science communicators.

t: Engineering Reborn S1 - "St. Louis Aquarium, Museum of African Art, Television Centre"
st: St. Louis Aquarium, Museum of African Art, Television Centre
d: A historic train station, grain silos, and broadcasting headquarters are transformed into state-of-the-art hubs.

t: Engineering Reborn S1 - "Maritime Museum, Coal Drops Yard, Peace Bunker"
st: Maritime Museum, Coal Drops Yard, Peace Bunker
d: A dry dock, coal depot, and Cold War tank shelter are reimagined into striking contemporary public spaces.
